Harden the repo's Claude Code Stop hook so it no longer treats a nested independent clone as the repo root. In addition to requiring a `.git`, it now also requires `git remote -v` to mention `mngr-internal`, so a session whose shell has wandered into `.external_worktrees/<clone>` (e.g. the default-workspace-template checkout, which has its own `.git` but a different remote) is nudged back to the mngr root before the other stop hooks run.
